name: Mithra

physical.wears: a red Phrygian cap, undyed working cloth, a satchel worn across the body

notes: Youth of the Survival Train, and the second of the two who lead it. Rides ahead of the train where Varuna walks beside it -- the same work at a different pace. Filler while the epoch is written out: enough for a playable traveller to exist in canon, not enough to be a story yet.
